text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a single 4px #005fcc focus ring with a 2px white box-shadow blur on every focusable element. This keeps the ring visible against any background while avoiding the complexity of a two-layer ring that can misalign or double up on touch devices. The trade-off is slightly softer edges on the ring, but the contrast and clarity for keyboard users outweighs that.

name: Reader
text: The single 4px ring with white blur fails on high-contrast mode: the white shadow blends into the background, making the ring invisible. A 2px solid white ring at 80% opacity behind the 4px #005fcc ring preserves visibility in all modes. Settle it with a live contrast test in Windows High Contrast Mode and a 100% zoom check.
